name: Quantum Leap Studios
description: Innovating the future of immersive gaming.
story: Quantum Leap Studios, based in Budapest, is a leading developer of cutting-edge virtual reality and augmented reality gaming experiences. Founded by avid motorsports enthusiasts, they see a natural synergy between the precision engineering and adrenaline-fueled excitement of racing and their own pursuit of technological excellence. They seek a partnership that showcases their brand to a global audience and provides valuable data for enhancing their racing simulation games.
